correction: The motivating dense-fixture transition was categorical low-to-middle band failover, not demonstrated within-band migration. Lineage detected the swap but added no value over selected_band for that mechanism.
cheap_check_precedence: Always evaluate selected-band stability first. Incremental lineage value must be demonstrated within selected-band strata and beyond the categorical warning.

load_bearing_control.name: occupancy_matched_low_lineage
load_bearing_control.construction: conjugate every context operator by one common orthogonal rotation mixing the planted low-band subspace with an orthogonal equal-rank subspace
load_bearing_control.varied: principal-angle lineage to the planted reference
load_bearing_control.unit_status: implemented; scale-up remains subject to resource enforcement
load_bearing_control.success_condition: band stability remains true while lineage tracks planted overlap and downstream utility changes

target_blind_features.worst_direction_retention: minimum squared singular value of U_ref^T U_t with zero padding under rank loss
target_blind_features.maximum_principal_angle_degrees: largest principal angle with 90 degrees assigned to missing reference dimensions

evaluation.primary_question: Within selected-band strata, does lineage add grouped-held-out predictive value beyond band identity, occupancy, rank, eigengap, norm, nuisance covariates, and Jacobian visibility?
evaluation.status_rule: descriptive until replicated real-model outcomes; no threshold may be tuned and evaluated on the same outcomes

claim_boundary: The unit control shows that lineage can separate identity from occupancy and band labels by construction. Real-model incremental value remains unestablished.
